paragraphs.text: A person commits the offense of assault upon a sports official if, while a sports official is acting as an official at an athletic contest in any sport at any level of amateur or professional competition, the person:
purposely or knowingly causes bodily injury to the sports official;
negligently causes bodily injury to the sports official with a weapon;
purposely or knowingly makes physical contact of an insulting or provoking nature with the sports official; or
purposely or knowingly causes reasonable apprehension of bodily injury in the sports official.
A person convicted of assault upon a sports official shall be fined an amount not to exceed $1,000 or be imprisoned in the county jail for any term not to exceed 6 months, or both.
